s: gakAraH । sa tu vyaYjanatftIyavarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM kaRWaH । (yaTA, “a-ku-ha-visarjjanIyAnAM kaRWaH .”) iti vyAkaraRam ॥ * ॥ “gakAraM parameSAni ! paYcadevAtmakaM sadA । nirguRaM triguRopetaM nirIhaM nirmmalaM sadA ॥ paYcaprARamayaM varRaM sarvvaSaktyAtmakaM priye ! । aruRAdityasaNkASAM kuRqalIM praRamAmyaham ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ * ॥ “sasargaH SlezitaH kaRWe vAyunA kAdimIrayet । vargasparSanamAtreRa kaM svarasparSanAttu Kam । stokagamBIrasaMsparSAdgavO NaYca vahirgatam ॥” iti prapaYcasAraH ॥ * ॥ (vaNgAkzarEstasya leKanaprakArAdiryaTA, -- “aDaHkuYcitareKA yA gAReSA sA prakIrttitA । tato dakzagatA yA tu kamalA tatra saMsTitA । aDogatA tato yA tu tasyAmISaH sadA vaset ॥” aDomuKena gatA punarUrdDvamuKenAgatetyarTaH ॥ * ॥ tasya DyAnaM yaTA, -- “DyAnamasyAH pravakzyAmi SfRuzva varavarRini ! । dAqimIpuzpasaNkASAM caturbbAhusamanvitAm ॥ raktAmbaraDarAM nityAM ratnAlaNkAraBUzitAm । evaM DyAtvA brahmarUpAM tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ tasya nAmAni yaTA, -- “gogOrI gOravo gaNgA gaReSo gokuleSvaraH । SArNgI paYcAtmako gATA ganDarvvaH sarvvagaH smftiH ॥ sarvvasidDiH praBA DUmrA dvijAKyaH SivadarSanaH । viSvAtmA gOH pfTagrUpA bAlabadDastrilocanaH ॥ gItaM sarasvatI vidyA BoginI nandano DarA । BogavatI ca hfdayaM jYAnaM jAlanDaro lavaH ॥” iti nAnAtantrAhftanAmAni ॥

v: gakAraH vyaYjanavarRaBedaH tasyoccAraRasTAnaM jihvAmUlarUpakaRWadeSaH, AByantaraprayatnaH jihvAmUlasparSaH, bAhyaprayatnAH saMvAranAdaGozAH alpaprARaSca । mAtfkAnyAse'sya dakziRamaRibanDe nyAsaH । asya DyeyarUpadevatAdikaM kAmaDenutantre uktaM yaTA “gakAraM parameSAni! paYcadevAtmakaM sadA । nirguRaM triguRAtItaM nirIhaM nirmalaM sadA । paYcaprARamayaM varRaM sarvaSaktyAtmakaM priye! । aruRAdityasaNkASaM kuRqalIM praRamAmyaham” । hfdayasTadvAdaSadalakamalasya kAdiWAntadvAdaSavarRayutatayA asya tanmaDyagatvam । asya vAcakaSabdA varRABiDAne uktA yaTA “go gOrI gOravaM gaNgA gaReSo gokuleSvaraH । SArNgI paYcAtmako gATA ganDarvaH sarvagaH smftiH । sarvasidDiH praBA DUmrA dvijAKyaH SivadarSanaH । viSvAtmA gOH pfTagrUpA BaRibanDastrilocanaH । gItaM sarasvatI vidyA BoginI nakuloDarA । tejasvatI ca hfdayaM jYAna jAlanGaro layaH” । kAvyAdiracanAyAmasyAsaMyuktatayA praTamavinyAse lakzmIH Palam । “kaH KogoGaSca lakzmIm” saMyuktaM ceha na syAt muKaBaraRapawurvargavinyAsayomaH । padyAdO gadyavaktre vacasi ca sakale prAkftAdO samo'yamiti” vf॰ ra॰ wI॰ sarvaSezatayokteH ।

m: 1. ग (3rd consonant of the alphabet), the soft guttural having the sound g in give
ग m. N. of Gaṇeśa, L.
2. ग mf(आ)n. (√ गम्) only ifc. going, moving (e.g. यान-, going in a carriage, Mn. iv, 120; Yājñ. iii, 291; शीघ्र-, going quickly, R. iii, 31, 3; cf. अन्तरिक्ष- &c.)
staying, being, abiding in VarBṛ.; Ragh. iii, 13; Kathās. &c. (e.g. पञ्चम-, abiding in or keeping the fifth place, Śrut.)
relating to or standing in connection with, R. vi, 70, 59; BhP. &c. (cf. अ-, अग्र-, अ-जिह्म-, अत्यन्त-, &c.; अग्रे-ग, &c.)
3. ग mf(ई, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 8)n. (√ गै) only ifc. singing (cf. छन्दो-, पुराण-, साम-)
ग m. a Gandharva or celestial musician, L.
4. ग (used in works on prosody as an abbreviation of the word गुरु to denote) a long syllable, W.
(in music used as an abbreviation of the word गान्धार to denote) the third note.
a: ग — a. (Used only at the end of comp.) Who or what goes, going, moving, being, staying, remaining, having sexual intercourse with &c. --गः 1 A Gandharva. --2 An epithet of Gaṇeśa. --3 A long syllable (used as an abbreviation of गुरु), (in prosody). --गा, --गं A song.
